newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-PARMA NEED TO BEAT VICENZA TO KEEP PRESSURE ON JUVE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PARMA NEED TO BEAT VICENZA TO KEEP PRESSURE ON JUVE.

text.p: Second-placed Parma need to win their home game against Vicenza on Sunday if they are to maintain their challenge to Italy's serie A leaders Juventus.
With five games to play, Juventus lead Parma by four points, with Internazionale a further four points back in third place
The coming week may prove decisive for the Italian championship since the rearranged calendar sees serie A clubs play three league games in eight days.
Parma are at home to AC Milan next Thursday and three days later they meet Juventus in Turin.
Juventus are away to second-from-bottom Verona on Sunday and go on to play Piacenza at home on Thursday before entertaining Parma.
But Parma need to win this Sunday in order go into that Turin game with a realistic chance of upsetting the championship standings.
Parma's international defender Fabio Cannavaro, however, is not convinced of his side's title chances.
"It's all just a bit too difficult for us and probably we'd do better to concentrate on securing the Champions' League (European Cup) spot with second place.
"However, it would be nice to help our coach (Carlo) Ancelotti win his first title...maybe even this year".
Parma will be at close to full strength, with Enrico Chiesa and Argentine Hernan Crespo leading the attack but with Croatian midfielder Mario Stanic still ruled out through injury.

Vicenza will be without Uruguayan Marcelo Otero, injured in their 1-0 defeat by Napoli in Thursday's Italian Cup final first leg, and will be led in attack by Gabriele Ambrosetti and Giovanni Cornacchinni.
